reads.need: The jobs here serve the people who live here
reads.evidence: 254 postings in all. Sales, food and teaching together are 38, more than engineering and software combined at 28.
reads.quality: The local work is shops, restaurants and childcare, in the town with the highest median rent of the ten at $3,449.
reads.move: Find out where the people who staff the town live and how they get in.
reads.why: No wages in the feed, so we cannot say how far the pay falls short of the rent.

reads.need: The steepest population drop of the ten
reads.evidence: Down 6.6% since 2020, with a median household income of $204,306.
reads.quality: The town is getting emptier and richer at once.
